title: Company Previews Next-Generation Tesla Semi, Earns EcoVadis Recognition
summary: A firsthand look at the latest Tesla Semi gives our team new insight as ArcBest continues building on its sustainability efforts.
body_markdown:
That progress is reflected in our latest EcoVadis assessment. ArcBest earned a[2026 EcoVadis Committed badge](https://recognition.ecovadis.com/ioi0INtQF0WMF3JDxuLD7w) , recognizing good sustainability management practices. EcoVadis assesses companies across Environment, Labor & Human Rights, Ethics and Sustainable Procurement, with ratings based on evidence of a company’s policies, actions and results.


“Achieving our highest EcoVadis score to date is an encouraging milestone, but it's also a reminder that sustainability is a journey,” said Rob Seal, ArcBest sustainability manager. “We're committed to responsible stewardship and continuous improvement across our operations.”


The Tesla Semi program and our latest EcoVadis assessment offer different views into where we can improve. We’ll continue applying what we learn to make practical progress while supporting our business and customers.


[Learn more about ArcBest’s sustainability program](https://arcb.com/about-arcbest/sustainability) .
